themes: Iconic Bavarian atmosphere, live music daily
Very tourist-heavy, especially midday and evenings
Food quality solid but not exceptional; experience matters more than cuisine
Communal seating — strangers share long tables, can feel chaotic
Service can be brisk/gruff during peak hours
Non-alcoholic options exist (soft drinks, Spezi, alcohol-free beer)
Central Altstadt location, easy walk from Marienplatz
review_summary.review_themes_disclaimer: Themes summarized from publicly visible TripAdvisor/Yelp/Booking snippets; no full-text review reproduced. No single-user anecdote promoted as fact.

crowd_estimate.notes: Schwemme floor is essentially always busy from 12:00 to 22:00. Upper-floor dining rooms and beer garden are calmer.

historical_significance.founding_note: Brewery founded by Duke Wilhelm V of Bavaria in 1589. Current Platzl building erected 1897. Famous since 19th century as royal court brewery.
historical_significance.modern_significance: Symbol of Munich and Bavaria; host to Oktoberfest-related events; widely recognized globally as iconic German cultural landmark.

non_alcoholic_alternatives_offered: Spezi (Coca-Cola + orange soda mix, very Bavarian)
minor_policy.minor_visible_notes: For gagaToday (target = underage Chinese students), all alcoholic menu items must be filtered out at game-render time. Only non-alcoholic drinks + food surface to the player character.

legal_entity.company_form_en: General partnership under German commercial law
legal_entity.ownership_note: The Platzl 9 restaurant is operated by Sperger Gaststättenbetrieb OHG (private family partnership). The Hofbräu beer served is brewed by the separately-owned 'Staatliches Hofbräuhaus München' (state-owned brewery at Hofmannstraße). Two distinct legal entities share the brand but have separate ownership.

leadership.structure_note: Wolfgang and Barbara Sperger are the legal representatives listed in the official Impressum. As OHG partners, they have unlimited personal liability for the business. The Sperger family has been associated with Hofbräuhaus operations since the early post-WWII era, though this historical detail was not re-verified in this draft.

on_site_manager.why_not_listed: The Hofbräuhaus official website does not publish the on-site Restaurantleiter's personal name or photo. This is a common practice for German restaurants (employee-level info, not legal disclosure). The Sperger family as OHG partners are the legal entity's representatives; the on-site operational manager is a separate (typically employed) role.
how_to_resolve: Phone the restaurant during office hours (Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00, +49 89 290 136 100) and ask who the current Restaurantleiter is
Search LinkedIn for 'Restaurantleiter Hofbräuhaus München' — current holder may have a public profile
Check Munich tourism press releases (muenchen.de) which sometimes name on-site managers of landmark venues

game_use.owner_contact_notes: In the player-character UI, do NOT show owner names, photos, or direct contacts. The legal-rep info is for compliance/audit only.
game_use.on_site_manager_game_role: Could enable A2/B1 roleplay tasks like 'speak to the manager about a complaint' or 'ask the Wirt for the day's recommendation' once a real name + verified photo is sourced. Until then, the manager NPC can be a generic adult-NPC placeholder without a real-person identifier.
